entities.name: Pierre Louis Prieur
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pierre Louis Prieur was a French lawyer elected to the Estates-General of 1789. During the French Revolution he served as a deputy to the National Convention and held membership in the Committee of Public Safety.
